notes: Emails send silently in the background: CLOSR now uses an Outlook sign-in token that is allowed to send (trying both Microsoft connections), so the Outlook fallback and its 'did the email go out?' question are gone; if the fallback is ever needed, CLOSR checks Sent Items itself. Progress shows on the Send button (Sending 3 of 10, Sent 3 of 10); the status bar only appears if something fails.
